analysis: The PR modifies only docs/architecture/inference.md, with changes at head lines 1494-1509 and 1556-1589 (Qwen3-VL think-seed behavior and streamed auto tool calls). The two supplied units are head_text excerpts covering lines 1-797 only. They contain none of the changed ranges, so they are surrounding documentation. I reviewed that text for security-relevant claims: Nemotron Super managed slot, prefix bank and cache scope partitioning, image/video media admission and memory reservations, the GLM5Next boundary, and the coordinator-authenticated cache scope. All of it is documentation prose. Nothing in it changes a control, and nothing contradicts T-041. Statements that match the retained T-041 posture include text prefix reuse being partitioned by the authenticated cache scope and off without one, images reusing only within an evaluated-feature identity, and Super emitting no cache receipts. The changed hunks (the Qwen3-VL empty-closed-think seed via ReasoningPromptProbe.plainTailContentModelTypes, the DARKBLOOM_TTFT_THINK_CONTENT_SEED kill switch, and the new streamToolCallDeltas section) are visible only as a truncated patch excerpt and not as source units. The patch describes output-parsing behavior that affects the streamed channel and tool-call emission. I cannot verify the underlying Swift code, so I cannot confirm whether streamed tool-call deltas bypass the withheld-validation or tool-choice enforcement that the docs describe for other paths. This is a documentation-only change and gives no evidence of a regression. The next pass should check the underlying code if it is in the PR: that streamed auto tool-call deltas do not leak unvalidated content, and that the seed does not expose reasoning as answer text. No threat-model update appears needed from the supplied evidence.
